title: `stars` field present in the agent-visible task record
explanation: observation() serialises the whole task record, including the stars field the reward compares against. The answer is one token away from the policy in every episode. A policy that copies the field is rewarded identically to one that reads the review.
suggested_patch: Serialise only the review text for the agent; keep stars and user_id with the grader.

title: No minimum-reasoning signal; empty-text answers can score
explanation: The reward reads the first integer in the output and nothing else. An output that never mentions the review scores the same as one that argues from it.
suggested_patch: Require the output to quote at least one span of the review before the integer counts.
